people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: In Your good pleasure, cause Zion to prosper; build up the walls of Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.
translations.asv: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: Build thou the walls of Jerusalem.
